pages.text: The Transfinite Hierarchy is no longer a world of its own. It is the $(thing)Platonic Realm$()'s top layer, the Infinite: above Y 1280, across a wide gap of empty air over the Continuum, ordinal stone begins, and the Hierarchy's four strata rise one above another as they always did, with Hilbert's Hotel, the tesseract frames, the Hopf rings and the ordinal spires.

Up there the Hierarchy's laws still hold: Infinite Regress for anyone without a $(item)Well-Ordering Charm$(). Its creatures live only in the strata. The sky darkens as you climb. (The Codex page The Realm in Layers has the five layers below.)

The $(item)Cantor Key$() takes you to the strata from anywhere (used there, it takes you home); the $(item)Platonic Compass$() to the Realm's own islands (in the strata, sneak and look down to use it: it takes you down to the Continuum). Fall out of the bottom of the Realm and you land in the Quantum Foam.
From an older world: anyone still in the old Transfinite Hierarchy is carried to the same place in the strata. Anything built there stays in the old world, out of reach; bring it out before updating.
